findings.text: The helper invokes the analyzer using resolved immutable commit IDs, but says its comparison must match the requested endpoints. G1 defines comparison.requested as the literal analyzer argument, so a user-provided symbolic ref such as main becomes a SHA in the analyzer report; comparing those literal values would reject a valid run. Define validation against the exact analyzer arguments and once-resolved commit/tree identities while retaining the user's original arguments separately in the execution report; test symbolic and moving refs.
